title: Seven voices:
title_short: AYH montage · More Happiness in Giving
headline: Seven people at a shoe giveaway answer “Are you happy?”, and every answer points to giving.
story: This is an Are You Happy? × Soles4Souls collab. Seven adults at the Mall of America shoe event answer the three Are You Happy? questions. Takara opens with the idea: there's more happiness in giving than in receiving.

Three fast parts, each led by the question on screen: Are you happy? (four quick yeses), What is the source of your happiness? (helping someone else), One message to the entire world (give back, we're good people, kindness, you have more to give). Takara closes: treat one another well. Warm, happy and fast.
do: Open on Takara already speaking on frame 1. Hook text on top.
Each question card about 1 s, over the next person smiling or listening.
Scale each person so faces are the same size in 9:16.
Keep the answers snappy. Cut on the last syllable.
Warm, upbeat music the whole way.
dont: No name supers. Seven names in 60 s is too many.
No faith lines (3160 00:33–00:56, 3172 00:22–00:26 and 00:49–00:56) unless Nick says yes.
Don't use Kara's “often invisible” or “over the moon”. Her own video uses them.
No Mall of America angle, no one person's full story.

tech: Sony MXF, 3840×2160 UHD, 23.98 fps, 16:9, 4 audio channels (camera operator's notes). One camera, locked off.
1080×1920 at 23.976 fps. Same rate as the source. No frame-rate change.
A 9:16 window of UHD is 1215×2160, so 100–112% stays sharp with no upscale. 120% is the max (small upscale). Keep the face in the center third.

Use Channel 2 (boom). The camera operator says it sounds best. Channel 1 = lavalier, backup only. Channels 3–4 = camera mic, mute. Map Channel 2 to both sides. Levels not measured here: check the waveform.
Air-conditioning hum on every Mall of America interview. Take a noise print from room tone in the same file first. Then noise reduction and a level pass. Do this before V1.
−14 LUFS integrated, −1 dBTP peak. Music well under the voice.
Burned in, US English. S4S style: black text on a teal #62CCBF box. Never white on teal. Large, max 2 lines. Keep the bottom 20% clear for app buttons.
H.264 MP4, 1080×1920. One file, 9:16 only. Upload to Frame.io → Ready for Review.
checklist: Soles4Souls and 4EveryKid are spelled exactly like this. The transcript says “Souls for Souls” and “For Every Kid”. Never caption that.
US English in every caption (favorite, not favourite).
Text is big enough to read on a phone at arm's length. This is the client's most common note.
Audio is cleaned: no hum, no level jumps between bites.
No logo, title card or fade at 0:00. No logo before the end card.
End card is the new S4S typography card. Only the CTA line changes.
Kara's “A little bit of kindness” is not in her own video. If it is, take it out here.
Faces are the same size from person to person.
